name: Sahathai Printing & Packaging Public Company Limited
summary: Established in 1969 and based in Bangkok, Thailand, Sahathai Printing & Packaging Public Company Limited delivers a full spectrum of printing and packaging solutions across the nation. Their extensive offerings span from initial design and development to pre-press preparation, the actual printing process, and post-press finishing. Furthermore, the company engages in the production of paper boxes and various publishing ventures.
